affected_protocol: neutral canonical-geometry diagnostic schema v4 and its frozen independent adjudicator

definite_producer_contract_mismatch.preregistered_arithmetic: Compute raw float64 centroids/areas/normals once, then use P=(X-c0)/40, C=(Craw-c0)/40, A=Araw/1600, and N=Nraw before one float32 cast.
definite_producer_contract_mismatch.v4_implementation: Recomputed centroids/areas/normals after centering and then recomputed them again from scaled points.
definite_producer_contract_mismatch.assessment: The routes are equivalent in exact arithmetic and no neutrality, target-exclusion, symmetry, scale-factor, or causal-bias flaw was identified, but they are not the same frozen arithmetic in a raw-byte-sensitive experiment.

definite_launch_manifest_bug.summary: The schema-v4 launch manifest required two audits of the exact frozen v3 diagnostic/preregistration/wrapper/adjudicator.
definite_launch_manifest_bug.consequence: That literal condition cannot license v4 because v3 was already superseded for a rank-zero runtime crash.

definite_adjudicator_false_passes: Resolved-path bundle inventories erased symlink identity and omitted broken symlinks and special filesystem entries.
Plain json.loads silently accepted duplicate object names with last-value-wins semantics, allowing forbidden content in the raw bytes to be hidden by a later duplicate key.
NPZ array-manifest shape dimensions accepted equality-coercible floats instead of true nonnegative integers.
Expected frozen files and DONE/STATUS markers were bound only by basename, so relocation away from the wrapper's frozen root-relative layout passed.
Caller paths traversing symlinked ancestor directories were resolved before alias rejection.
The complete manifest was not an allowlist: a recorded extra target-payload file passed while target exclusion was reported clean.
replacement_requirements: Implement the literal preregistered one-geometry arithmetic and test its raw intermediate fields.
Bind a new launch manifest to the schema-v5 producer rather than superseded v3/v4 artifacts.
Inventory bundle entries lexically; reject symlinks, symlinked ancestors, and special files.
Reject duplicate/non-finite JSON and equality-coerced schema identities.
Bind frozen inputs, outputs, and completion markers to exact root-relative wrapper paths.
Require the copied bundle to equal a closed path allowlist so no extra target or truth payload can be persisted.
